Navitas Semiconductor new entrant Innoscience GaN threat AI data center 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列出主要 GaN 對手（Infineon、Power Integrations、TI、Innoscience、Renesas、EPC）與 SiC 對手（Infineon、Wolfspeed、onsemi、ROHM、Qorvo、ST）；多數對手財力遠大於公司。
findings.excerpt: Our primary GaN competitors include Infineon Technologies AG, Power Integrations, Inc., Texas Instruments Incorporated, Innoscience (Suzhou) Semiconductor Co., Ltd., Renesas Electronics Corp., and Efficient Power Conversion Corporation (EPC). Our primary SiC competitors include Infineon, Wolfspeed, Inc., ON Semiconductor Corporation, ROHM Co., Ltd., Qorvo, Inc., and STMicroelectronics International N.V.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：可能出現新競爭者或傳統大廠推出 GaN／高壓 SiC 方案；設計一旦被採用，客戶通常要到下一代才換，失去設計案將損失份額。
findings.excerpt: Unpredictable Competitive Dynamics: To the extent new and emerging products and technologies reshape or create new market landscapes, the competitive environment may evolve in unexpected ways. For example, new competitors may emerge, or traditional competitors with established R&D and manufacturing resources, and long-standing customer relationships, may choose to offer competitive GaN or high-voltage SiC solutions.

findings.claim: 10-K：營收受份額得失與設計案進展影響，且行動／消費市場受競爭與定價壓力，與公司轉向高功率有關。
findings.excerpt: gains and losses in market share and design win traction, including the Company’s ability to ramp new high-power products; •pace at which technology is adopted in our end markets; •the stage of our products in their respective life cycles; •the effects of competition and competitive pricing strategies, particularly in the mobile and consumer markets impacted by our announced transition to high-power markets

findings.claim: onsemi 2026-06 推出面向 AI 資料中心的 GaN 產品組合 GaNEXUS；ST 2026-05 推出 700V GaN 供 AI 伺服器，大廠加入 GaN 競爭。

note: 搜尋未找到第三方量化份額消長數據；onsemi GaNEXUS（2026-06）、ST 700V GaN（2026-05）為搜尋摘要轉述，列 clues 待核。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
